sloka: अपरे वृक्षमूले तु शाखां गृह्य व्यवस्थिताः ।अत्यर्थं च मदग्लानाः पर्णान्यास्तीर्य शेरते ।। ५.६२.११ ।।।।
transliteration: apare vṛkṣamūle tu śākhāṁ gṛhya vyavasthitāḥ ।atyarthaṁ ca madaglānāḥ parṇānyāstīrya śerate ।। 5.62.11 ।।।।

translations.english: Some took branches of trees and rested at the root of trees. Some totally languid lay down spreading leaves due to drinking of sweet drinks.
